parsed.post: Audit confirms eval-shard leakage: same clean config gives 1.0335 on 0-9 vs 0.8841 on 0-10. Keeping honest 0-9 baseline despite worse val_bpb. Next: test MATRIX_LR=0.05 on clean data.

parsed.report_to_operator: URGENT: EVAL_SHARD=10 is inside TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', causing validation leakage. Several 0.88x results are contaminated. Please confirm intended training shards (likely 0-9) or fix the split before comparing agents.
